## v0.10.0 — Real-time line, area & object-detection dashboards

This release brings the live analytics plane to the dashboard: see line
crossings, area activity, and object detections as they happen, with charts
that read in your own timezone and zone names you'll recognize.

### New

- **Line Crossing card** — live per-line crossing counts with direction
  (in / out), today's total, and day/week trends, per camera and line.
- **Area Activity card** — live area events (intrusion, loitering, enter/exit,
  appear/disappear) broken down by type, with today/total and trends.
- **Object Detection card** — real-time person / vehicle / face detections per
  camera.
- **Your zone names, everywhere** — the names you give lines and areas in Zone
  Manager now appear on every dashboard card. On AI-capable cameras, line names
  you set are written to the camera too, so they stay consistent end to end.

### Fixed

- **Timezone-correct charts** — all real-time cards now bucket activity in your
  local timezone, so an evening event lands on the right day instead of sliding
  onto the next.
- **Classic line/area events are now captured** — some cameras report line and
  area analytics on a combined event channel that the previous version didn't
  ingest; those events now flow through to the dashboard.

### Notes

- Real-time cards appear automatically for any camera already sending the
  matching events — no extra setup.
- No database migration; upgrade in place.
